description.value: Enroute.cc is a performance cycling apparel shop and café hybrid in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, carrying premium brands such as Pas Normal Studios, MAAP, Rapha, and ASSOS alongside race nutrition from Maurten and Precision Hydration. The physical retail space doubles as a café — a format beloved in road cycling culture — making it a destination stop for cyclists seeking both kit and coffee on Vancouver's popular West Side riding corridors. Its location on West 1st Avenue places it directly along routes connecting the Seawall and Kitsilano to Point Grey.
